# Image for Net Linux version features added

2026-09-07

## overview

Added a feature that was inconvenient when adding photos to the website.

![UI](essays/2026-09-07-imagefornet.png)

* **Image resizing (resizing)**:
  * Choose from 3 presets (Large: 1920px, Medium: 1280px, Small: 800px) and easily resize based on the long side while maintaining the aspect ratio.
* **Batch sequential number change of file name**:
  * Sequential numbers (e.g. `photo_001.jpg`, `photo_002.jpg`...) can be automatically generated and saved in batches from the specified base name (prefix) and starting number.

* **Add watermark**:
  * The font size was set as the ratio to the image.

* **Existing features**:
  * Delete EXIF ​​information
  * Add watermark*
  * Multi-platform compatible

## solution

At this point, there is no need to use a separate image app.
Next, it would be even more useful if there was a function to pick up images to post on SNS etc.
